deeptime.configuration.title: Deep Time
deeptime.configuration.defaultWorldType: Create World starts on Deep Time
Opens the Create World screen with Deep Time Planet as the world type. Create then simulates the planet's history (a few minutes) and plays it. The other world types stay in the World tab.
deeptime.configuration.dhAutoCurvature: Distant Horizons curvature follows the planet
deeptime.configuration.dhAutoCurvature.t: In a Deep Time world, bends Distant Horizons' far terrain to the planet's own curvature (a sphere of circumference / 2 pi blocks) unless you set Distant Horizons' Earth Curve Ratio yourself. It uses Distant Horizons' API override, so its config file is never rewritten, and puts the setting back when you leave.
